# ADR-001: Pin latest Original Destiny and preserve Rust history

Status: chosen

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Use main at 114e89fa584f0e1a81eb0a679aabf41af8870072, selected by the user, while retaining the 531-case earlier catalog as a source-equal subset and the new partition regression.

## Rationale

The user explicitly requested the newest source and preservation of existing Rust work.

## Alternatives

Remain on the older catalog authority; support both revisions as separate targets.

## Consequences

The full matrix has 532 cases. Historical 531-case Aegis/catalog metadata remains historical and cannot define the complete denominator.
